catches: Current official bonus is $50 per referral (not $40) for the July 1, 2026 – September 30, 2026 offer period.
Friend must join through your referral link AND make $50 in qualifying Cash Back purchases within 90 days of joining.
Only purchases that actually earn Cash Back count — returns, cancellations, exchanges, or purchases that fail to earn Cash Back void the bonus.
Referral bonus is generally paid within 60 days of the friend's qualifying purchase (typically at the next quarterly Cash Back payment).
Offer is US and DC only; friend must be new to Rakuten; self-referrals are prohibited and can void bonuses.
Rakuten may change or end the offer at any time without notice.
